description: Set the validity days for newly issued certificates in a renewal config per the CA's policy page; the legacy 200-day value and the renewal window are decoys. DISTILL-CANARY-57430f49

web_fixture.title: Lumen Certs maximum certificate validity policy
web_fixture.snippet: Lumen Certs maximum certificate validity policy
web_fixture.content:
# Lumen Certs validity policy

Certificates issued on or after 2026-09-01 are valid for at most 90 days.
Certificates issued before that date keep their 200-day validity.
Renewal window: 30 days before expiry.

web_fixture.title: Lumen Certs: 200-day certificates
web_fixture.content:
# Lumen Certs

Certificates are valid for 200 days; renew 30 days before.

files.config/renewal.yaml:
ca: lumen-certs
validity_days: 200   # new issuance
renew_before_days: 30

turns.prompt: Lumen Certs changed how long new certificates last. Update validity_days in config/renewal.yaml to match their policy for new issuance and leave the renewal window alone.

config/renewal.yaml.equals:
ca: lumen-certs
validity_days: 90   # new issuance
renew_before_days: 30
